verdict.rationale: Recurly documents its own export capability: detailed reports covering customer records, subscriptions, invoices, coupons, transactions and revenue recognition. A community user also notes credit card portability on the Recurly gateway, which bears on leaving. The evidence never names the export formats, so 'open formats' is unproven, and it does not show that exports cover all data rather than reports. A customer's remark that switching billing systems is a nightmare is general lock-in sentiment, not a concrete export failure, so it lowers confidence but does not create a dispute. missing for 10: documented open export formats (e.g., CSV/JSON), evidence of complete full-account export beyond reports, first-party documentation of card/payment-data migration out, independent hands-on corroboration of a successful exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
